mapper.select:
SELECT p.* FROM commerce_product p LEFT JOIN commerce_merchant m ON m.id = p.merchant_id AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 LEFT JOIN commerce_store s ON s.id = p.store_id AND s.merchant_id = p.merchant_id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.audit_status = 2 AND p.sale_status = 1 AND ((p.seller_type = 1 AND m.id IS NOT NULL AND s.id IS NOT NULL) OR (p.seller_type = 2 AND p.seller_user_id IS NOT NULL)) AND p.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM commerce_product_sku sku WHERE sku.product_id = p.id AND (sku.merchant_id = p.merchant_id OR (sku.merchant_id IS NULL AND p.merchant_id IS NULL)) AND sku.deleted = 0 AND sku.status = 0 )
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.seller_type = #{req.sellerType}
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.storeKeyword}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM commerce_product_sku price_sku WHERE price_sku.product_id = p.id AND price_sku.deleted = 0 AND price_sku.status = 0 AND price_sku.price >= #{req.minPrice} AND price_sku.price <= #{req.maxPrice} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM commerce_product_sku stock_sku WHERE stock_sku.product_id = p.id AND stock_sku.deleted = 0 AND stock_sku.status = 0 AND stock_sku.stock > 0 )
ORDER BY (SELECT MIN(sort_sku.price) FROM commerce_product_sku sort_sku WHERE sort_sku.product_id = p.id AND sort_sku.deleted = 0 AND sort_sku.status = 0) ASC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY (SELECT MIN(sort_sku.price) FROM commerce_product_sku sort_sku WHERE sort_sku.product_id = p.id AND sort_sku.deleted = 0 AND sort_sku.status = 0) DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.sort ASC, p.id DESC
